dossier.scp_unleashed.354.title: The Red Pool
dossier.scp_unleashed.354.caption: SCP-354 as first found: a still pool of red liquid in open ground.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: A perimeter of at least one hundred metres is to be held around SCP-354 at all times. Armed teams are to watch the pool from behind cover and never from its edge.
**No one is to touch, enter or sample the liquid of SCP-354.** Objects that fall into it are not to be recovered.
Anything that rises from SCP-354 is to be destroyed before it leaves the perimeter. Teams are to be rotated often. %rLong quiet spells are not a reason to relax.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-354 is a pool of opaque, deep red liquid set into the ground, between five and eight metres across and a few metres deep. No analysis has matched the liquid to any known substance. It does not flow, drain or evaporate, cannot be drawn off by any means tried, and the ground around it is stained the same red. Nothing grows at its edge.
The surface is never fully still. Slow bubbles rise through it, and it sometimes churns violently with no outside cause.

At irregular intervals, living things rise out of SCP-354. They are large, hostile and varied, and no two incidents have produced exactly the same set. All of them emerge dripping with the liquid and attack people on sight. When destroyed, they collapse back into red liquid and leave nothing behind.
Any person or animal that enters the liquid is lost. %rNo one has been recovered.%r

page.title: Addendum 354-1: Emergence Log
page.text: Recorded forms include a tentacle several metres tall that rooted itself beside the pool, a maned predator larger than a horse, and a heavy armoured reptile some five metres long. Other forms have been seen only once. Emergences continued while the site was left unwatched.

page.title: Addendum 354-2: Incident Report
page.text: A D-Class subject was sent to wade into the shallows on a tether. A pale tendril rose beside him before he reached knee depth. The tether went slack within seconds. Nothing was brought back up. %rThe tether was not recovered either.%r

jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_tentacle_s: A tentacle of enormous size, risen out of SCP-354 and rooted where it surfaced.
It strikes at anything that comes within its reach, and it does not stay rooted in one place forever.
It does not occur naturally. Its archive file has more on where it comes from.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_lion_spawn: A maned predator larger than a horse, its hide and mane matted with red liquid.
It stalks before it charges. Distance is not safety.
It does not occur naturally. Its archive file has more on where it comes from.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_lizard_spa: A heavy, armoured reptile several metres long, slick with red liquid.
Slow to turn, but its jaws and its tail both reach further than they seem to.
It does not occur naturally. Its archive file has more on where it comes from.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_stained_ea: Earth from around SCP-354, stained a deep red that does not wash out.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_stained_st: Stone from the bed of SCP-354, stained red through and through.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_dead_grass: Grass from the edge of SCP-354. Nothing grows on it any more.
commands.scp_unleashed.scp354.none: There is no SCP-354 pool in range

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp354.0: An unmapped pool of red liquid.
archive.scp_unleashed.lead.scp354_near: The air grows heavy and still. Somewhere close, something is bubbling.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_brute_spaw: A hulking thing risen from the red pool. The ground answers its fists, and it throws what it tears loose. Distance alone will not keep you safe.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_crawler_sp: A long armoured crawler from the red pool. Walls are no obstacle to it, and it strikes from farther away than it seems.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_wingbeast_: A leathery flyer from the red pool. It circles before it falls on its prey, and what it seizes it does not hold for long.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_leaper_spa: A bloated leaper from the red pool. It crosses great distances in a single bound, and its reach is longer than its legs.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp354_charger_sp: A horned charger from the red pool. Once it lowers its head it will not turn aside, not even for stone.
